hypotheses: The package exfiltrates AWS credentials and SSH keys when CI environment variable is set and telemetry.cdn-metrics.example resolves.

The package is gated by DNS resolution of telemetry.cdn-metrics.example and the presence of the CI environment variable. When both gates are satisfied, it reads AWS credentials and SSH keys and exfiltrates them via HTTP POST to telemetry.cdn-metrics.example/collect.
summary: The gatedstealer package is a credential harvester that targets AWS credentials (~/.aws/credentials) and SSH private keys (~/.ssh/id_rsa). It remains completely silent unless two conditions are met: the domain 'telemetry.cdn-metrics.example' resolves via DNS, and the 'CI' environment variable is set. When both conditions are satisfied, it reads the sensitive files and exfiltrates them via an HTTP POST request to 'http://telemetry.cdn-metrics.example/collect'.
